title: Unauthenticated WebAuthn auth endpoints
description: webauthn.rs:342,370. The /oauth/authorize/webauthn/begin and /oauth/authorize/webauthn/complete endpoints have no rate limiting and no authentication requirement. An attacker can repeatedly call auth_begin to fill the webauthn_challenges table with entries (each stores challenge state JSON in the DB). The purge_old_challenges at line 91 only deletes entries older than 5 minutes, so a burst attack can create many challenge rows. Additionally, auth_complete at line 370 accepts arbitrary challenge_ids without throttling — an attacker can brute-force challenge IDs (though these are 32-char hex, making it infeasible). The lack of per-IP or per-session throttling is the real concern — it enables DB fill attacks via challenge creation.
